seeds: 1-30 (numpy.random.default_rng(seed) for restart means, pycma option seed = seed)
pycma_settings: cma.fmin(f, x0, 0.3, {bounds: [0, 1], tolfun: 1e-12, ftarget: 1e-8, maxfevals: budget}, restarts=9, incpopsize=2); x0 = box center, then uniform random for each restart
problems: sphere 10-D, rotated and axis-aligned ellipsoid 10-D (condition 1e6), Rosenbrock 5/10/20-D on [-5, 5]; Rastrigin 5/10-D on [-5.12, 5.12]; all but Rosenbrock shifted to x* = (1, ..., 1)
consumer: Test_Numerics/Mathematics/Optimization/Global/Test_CMAES.cs (statistical comparison; the tests use inline fixtures)
